name: i_love_u
source:
You log back in after a long break. The Vice Chief posts a cursed link said to kill its visitors. Arguments erupt, paranoia spreads. Then a bright new user appears. Your AI pauses: 'Unknown profile detected'.

[From [url=https://smallcritter.itch.io/i-love-u]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在长时间休息后重新登录。副酋长发布了一个被诅咒的链接，据说会杀死其访问者。争论爆发，偏执蔓延。然后一个聪明的新用户出现了。你的AI暂停：“检测到未知的个人资料”。

[来自[url=https://smallcritter.itch.io/i-love-u]Itch.io[/url]]
